items.t: Moody’s downgrades Hertz to Caa1 as 2028 refinancing risks mount
items.sum: Investin.com -- Moody’s Ratings downgraded Hertz Global Holdings Inc's (NASDAQ:HTZ) corporate family rating to Caa1 from B2 on Monday while maintaining a negative outlook, citing sluggish financial recovery and mounting refinancing risks.
